headline: Flying Pandas climbs to 24th on ARC-2

sections.text: Flying Pandas gained 12.91 points to reach 54.58, moving from 42nd to 24th on the ARC-AGI-2 public board.
The climb moves the team further into the standings. The board's 16 gold places are led by a cutoff of 64.72, so the climb has not yet reached the medal line.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
